Frequently Asked Questions

How often do Spatial Rifts open in Aion 2?⌄

Spatial Rifts open every 3 hours, at 02:00, 05:00, 08:00, 11:00, 14:00, 17:00, 20:00 and 23:00 server time — 8 openings per day. Each region’s server uses its own local clock: pick your region and the countdown converts the next opening to your timezone.

When is the next Abyss event?⌄

The Artifact Siege (Abyss) takes place on Monday, Thursday and Saturday at 21:00 server time, and the Executor bosses appear at 21:30. Guardian Lord Nahma appears on Friday and Sunday at 21:00. The live timer above shows each time in your own zone.

Which world bosses are there and when do they spawn?⌄

Reshanta hosts field bosses such as Watcher Kaira, Executor Argo/Kaira/Tamasa, Enraged Guardian Lord Nahma, Executioner Dramos, Ravager Marakha and Turncoat Ducal. Each shows its next spawn and a link to its exact location on the interactive map.

What timezone does Aion 2 use?⌄

Each Aion 2 Global region has its own server clock — North America East UTC-4, North America West UTC-7, Europe UTC+2, South America UTC-3 and Japan UTC+9 (Taiwan and Korea follow a different schedule). Offsets can shift by one hour with daylight saving time. Pick your region and every time on this page is converted to your device’s timezone.
